role: Independent final publication PDF review; reviewer did not author the AlphaProof translation.

compilation.underfull_explanation: Two loose hboxes in Extended Data Table 2, AlphaProof + TTRL rows at source lines 26 and 27. Actual final page 30 inspected at overview and 216 DPI; wraps are legible, no overlap or clipping.

visual_review.high_resolution_method: PyMuPDF page.get_pixmap(matrix=Matrix(3,3)); viewed with detail original (216 DPI).
checks: Every page individually opened: title/TOC, main text, all Methods, figures/captions, three tables/notes, complete proof images, authors/licence, all bibliography pages.
Final pages 15–16: all four displayed search formulas checked at high resolution, source sign anomaly note intact.

Final pages 25/27/29: complete original proof images from first import to final tactic, highlights and right/bottom edges visible. P6 image page 29; caption, printed label and resolved named destination all page 30 checked separately.
Final pages 10/30: all three table values/headers/notes visible; 39.4/39.5 source discrepancy note intact.
Final page 23: all a–j variants and original source marks retained.
Final page 32: all thirty-nine author names, accents, CC links and © The Author(s) 2025 present.
visual_review.result: No missing glyph, cropped figure/code, intersecting table values, content outside page, or unreadable annotation detected.
cosmetic_observations: Pages 5 and 8 have substantial whitespace because a large figure starts the following page.
Pages 26 and 28 are short prose continuations after complete proof images; page 39 is a short bibliography ending. These are layout tradeoffs, not missing pages.

links.scope: Every annotation rectangle and destination/URI syntax checked. Named links resolved to valid final pages. This does not claim every remote web endpoint was live or permission-free at review time.

manual_source_figure_table_labels.navigation_note: P6 complete image remains physical page 29; caption, printed label and its own named destination now all physical page 30 after Needspace. All seventeen manual figure/table labels have distinct destinations and match their printed label pages.

limits: No execution or independent kernel verification of the Lean artifacts.
No scientific validation of AlphaProof performance or resolution of original AND/V/Q inconsistency.
No exhaustive live HTTP audit of every external cited URL.

incremental_freeze_check.change: Needspace before P6 figure caption phantomsection; no scientific content change.
incremental_freeze_check.visual_evidence_transfer: All 39 final overview pages and 9 key highres pages are pixel-identical to the independently actually viewed earlier freeze. No new visible page needs viewing.
